SELECT store_id, active_customers, CAST(active_customers AS REAL) / total_active, CAST(active_customers AS REAL) / avg_store_active
FROM (
  SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS active_customers,
         SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_active,
         AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS avg_store_active
  FROM customer
  WHERE active = 1
  GROUP BY store_id
)
